items.title: Finds duplicates
items.text: The same receipt sent by two people or photographed again. Nota flags the duplicate so no invoice gets paid twice.

items.title: Keeps a document archive
items.text: Nota saves each file to a folder in your Google Drive under its row number. No need to scroll through the chat: you open the original from the sheet in one click.

items.title: Works in your currency
items.text: Converts payments in other currencies at the central bank rate on the payment date. You can change the currency at any time.

items.title: No silent guessing

data.title: Your data

items.title: Access to the sheet and folder only
items.text: Nota creates them itself in your Google Drive.

items.title: Your documents stay with you
items.text: The sheet and the originals are stored in your Google Drive.

items.title: We keep only fingerprints
items.text: We store only file fingerprints, to find duplicates. We keep documents only while processing them and discard non-payment files right away. We don't train AI on your documents.

items.title: Delete with one command
items.text: We erase document fingerprints and history, disconnect from Google, and the bot leaves all groups. Only your Telegram username and payment records remain. The sheet, folder and documents stay with you.

data.who: Nota is built on more than 15 years of Axiom Consulting's experience in financial control for businesses in the CIS and Southeast Asia.

faq.a: Any payment document: store receipts, bills and invoices, delivery notes (including crumpled and handwritten ones), and screenshots of bank transfers. PDFs and photos, in any language; a multi-page PDF is read page by page. The bot skips non-payment files such as contracts, passports or site photos, and they don't count toward your limit.

faq.q: An invoice and a screenshot of its payment: is that two rows?
faq.a: If the screenshot confirms payment of an invoice that's already recorded, Nota asks what to do with it: add it as a separate row or skip it. You can save your choice as the default, and the bot won't ask again.

faq.q: When will I get the first report?
faq.a: For an archive of up to 30 documents, in about 15 minutes. The bot tells you right away that the archive is being processed. If you forward receipts one at a time, the bot records them, and the first report arrives on its own after 30 documents. You can also get a report earlier, at any time, with the “Report” button.

faq.q: What if I don't connect Google?
faq.a: Without Google, you get only the archive report. The sheet, duplicate alerts and scheduled reports need Google. The bot keeps everything you've sent for 7 days: connect Google within that time, and the archive and any separate files go into the sheet. If you don't connect it, the data is deleted after 7 days, and you keep the report.

faq.q: What happens after the 30 free documents?
faq.a: Nota sends a report on the first 30 documents, even if your archive has more. They already show you how the bot reads your receipts and delivery notes. After that, you choose and pay for a plan using the payment button at the top of your sheet. Everything already in the sheet stays in your Google Drive, along with the folder of originals, even if you don't pay.

faq.q: Does Nota read messages in the group?
faq.a: No. The bot processes only messages with files and skips text messages. From those files, it takes only payment documents and discards non-payment ones right away. The bot doesn't post in the group. It only marks each recorded receipt with ✍ and tells you about duplicates in a private chat. The group is optional: you can forward receipts to the bot in a private chat.

faq.q: My team uses WhatsApp. Will it work?
faq.a: Yes. The bot itself runs in Telegram, but you can export a WhatsApp archive right from your phone: chat → “Export chat”, with media. Send the archive to the bot whenever it suits you, or forward receipts one at a time.

faq.q: I'm an accountant with several clients. How should I use it?
faq.a: One plan and one sheet for all of them. Create a Telegram group for each client and forward that client's receipts there: Nota records them under the right client in the Business Unit column. You can download the sheet as Excel or CSV.

faq.q: What language is the sheet in?
faq.a: The sheet is in English. The bot speaks Russian, English and Indonesian, and understands documents in any language. It converts payments in other currencies into yours at the central bank rate on the payment date.

faq.q: How does Nota know what's been paid?
faq.a: Nota sets the “Paid” status when the document itself confirms payment, such as a store receipt or a payment slip. You mark “To pay” yourself. Invoices to pay appear on the Insights tab by due date.

faq.q: Is this accounting software? Will it work for our accountant?
faq.a: It's not accounting software. Nota shows where the money goes and who gets it, and flags duplicates and unusual amounts. Taxes and reporting stay with your accountant, who will find a ready-made sheet with links to the originals useful. You can download it as Excel or CSV and import it into Jurnal, Zoho or another system. There's no direct export yet.
Cash without a receipt, spending with no document, and advances paid to the foreman. Nota doesn't know market prices, but it flags a payment several times larger than usual on the Insights tab.
